Muhammad Hamza Raza
💫 About Me: I am Muhammad Hamza Raza i am a Developer driven by the intersection of Artificial Intelligence and Interactive Environments. With a strong foundation in Python and a growing expertise in Unity Game Development, I focus on building software that is both intelligent and engaging.
What I’m Working On: AI & Machine Learning: Developing RAG pipelines and exploring Agentic AI to create autonomous systems. Game Development: Utilizing Unity and C# to build interactive experiences, focusing on clean logic and smooth gameplay mechanics. Data Engineering: Leveraging Python (Pandas/NumPy) for data profiling and cleaning to ensure high-quality inputs for ML models.
Technical Toolkit: Languages: Python, C# AI/ML: LLMs, RAG, AI Agents. Game Dev: Unity Engine, C# Scripting, Game Logic
